inbox.title: Incoming Contributions
inbox.description_scoped: Pending change requests for the selected shared deck.
inbox.description_all: Review each changed note, accept some or all of it, or decline. The contributor's personal edits are always kept.

detail.title: Change Request Details
detail.actions_desc: Review and manage this contribution based on its current status.
detail.description_empty: The contributor did not provide a description.
detail.pending_review_notice: Your contribution is waiting for the author. You can keep editing your own copy in the library.
detail.merged_notice: The author accepted this contribution. Other learners see it once the author publishes a new version.
detail.rejected_notice: The contribution was declined. Your personal edits are kept.
detail.conflicts_desc: Compare the original you edited, your version and the author's current version, then choose a result for each field.
detail.conflict_remaining_desc: Filter to notes with conflicts to settle each field.
detail.toast_sync_conflicts: The original content changed. Resolve the conflicting fields before sending.
detail.toast_approve_success: Accepted the changes into your deck. Other learners see them after you publish.
detail.toast_reject_success: Declined; the contributor's personal edits are kept.
detail.conflict_upstream_local_title: You and the author both changed this field.
detail.accept_hint: Untick notes or fields you do not want. Anything you leave out stays in the contributor's personal edits.
detail.nothing_selected: Select at least one change to accept.

release.base_publishing_desc: Applying drafts to the published deck.

request.preservation_title: Your personal edits and learning progress are preserved
